items.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) Expands Enterprise Reach With Managed Secure Networking Launch
items.summary: Charter Communications (NasdaqGS:CHTR) Spectrum Business introduced a Managed Cisco Secure Networking solution for enterprise customers in a new service launch. The offer combines Cisco routing hardware with Cisco security capabilities and threat intelligence in a managed subscription package. The service targets business needs around security, network visibility and flexible connectivity within Charter's enterprise networking portfolio.
